$comment: Module ownership for design-system releases. Every design-system source file belongs to exactly one module. A change to a file owned by another module is a cross-module touch and needs that module's review as well. Generated files are rebuilt from src/design/tokens.ts on compose, never patched.

tokens-themes.title: Tokens and themes
tokens-themes.description: Colour, shape, depth, size and motion tokens; dark/light/system themes; the Tailwind mapping and platform utilities; the token pipeline and its tests; surface primitives and the component barrel.

sharedSections.src/design/tokens.ts: Owns colors, membership, shadows, radius, space, sizes, motion and MIN_TOUCH_TARGET. The fonts and type sections belong to typography.

typography.title: Typography
typography.description: Font stacks and the type scale (the fonts and type sections of tokens.ts), heading roles, label and the wordmark.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: Button variants and sizes, press feedback, the pending SubmitButton.

forms.title: Forms
forms.description: Text fields, selects, field wrappers and messages, choice controls, live checklists, step progress and inline alerts.

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.description: Tab bar and sidebar, the app/onboarding/auth shells (page header, form footer, back link, compliance note), grouped lists and empty states.

membership.title: Membership
membership.description: The membership card, Creator Status and status badges, verification marks.

financial.title: Financial patterns
financial.description: Consent text, figures and amounts, and the financial-trust presentation rules. ComplianceNote lives in shells.tsx (navigation), so changing it is a cross-module touch.
